rows.note: net-aware `clearance` always; the net-agnostic fab-view pass (`physical_copper_gap`, #8843) adds same-net copper but runs only when the effective --mfr is exactly `jlcpcb` -- a `jlcpcb-tier*` profile gets `clearance` alone. Observed 2 danger (0.08 mm). Since #8938 the pass judges gaps with no pad and no zone fill on either side at trace_spacing's recorded bands from the resolved stackup's dfm_thresholds entry (previously hardcoded 0.10/0.15 mm constants): below the danger edge is an error; with no recorded warning_mm there is no warning band, and gaps at or above the danger edge are not reported (the fab recorded 0 danger / 0 warning for trace_spacing on the 4-layer 1 oz #8938 board). Since #8972 those trace-band findings count toward this row, not `pad_spacing`.

as `trace_spacing`, plus the 2 oz pad mask-bridge check inside `physical_copper_gap`; that check runs on outer layers only (#8913) and judges a declared 2 oz outer weight only, otherwise reporting `physical_copper_gap_incomplete` at info. Observed 8 danger. Since #8938: gaps with a pad on either side (no zone fill) are judged at pad_spacing's recorded bands, and a same-net gap below the danger edge is an ERROR -- the fab cannot see nets and flags it regardless (the 4-layer 1 oz board's 6 danger are same-net via/track at 0.065-0.099 mm from a pad edge); the finding is labelled `same_net` so the class can be waived deliberately. Reported, not reproduced (#9034): on one further 4-layer board (not committed) kct reported 19 errors against the fab's 6 danger + 1 warning; the surplus cause is unmeasured, but kct emits at most one finding per copper-source pair per layer (closest measurement wins -- measured on the #9034 fixture), so it cannot come from per-edge inflation within a pair. No fab-sourced edge justifies a threshold change, so the stricter same-net error stays (#8938). Zone-fill (pour) gaps are kct's own advisory only and report at info, not tiered: JLCDFM does not judge pour clearance -- 1,516 pour-to-pad gaps at 0.10-0.13 mm went unflagged on the #8938 board -- so kct's warning count for this category exceeds the fab's by that population by design.

`mask_to_copper` is default-on for an explicit --mfr `jlcpcb*` since #8842 (interim 0.09 mm danger / 0.15 mm warning); a bare `kct check` with no --mfr does not engage it, and the native path needs an unmodified saved source. Observed 5 danger. The rule has no same-net exclusion and traces are in its comparison set, so the fab's same-net track-in-pad-opening items are in scope; since #8914 an assessment that could not complete reports `mask_to_copper_incomplete` at info, so zero findings no longer read as a clean board. Whether the #8914 report's zero count was an incomplete run or a measurement gap is still unresolved.

`tht_smd_spacing` (#8843) judges plated through-hole component pads plus, since #8914, vias whose drill is at least 1.0 mm (the fab classes a hole by size: the three top-side dangers kct missed on the #8914 board were all 1.3-1.42 mm wire-anchor vias). Since #8925 an anchor via is also judged against any exposed (untented) via annulus -- the fab's `smd` side counts a small exposed via pad (#8914 item 5); THT component pads are not paired with via annuli, and tented annuli are skipped (the fab's exact tenting test is unverified). Still skipped: same-footprint pad pairs and sub-1.0 mm fan-out vias as the hole side. A pad shape the rule cannot measure now reports `tht_smd_spacing_incomplete` at info instead of vanishing. Fab-view gated -- runs only when the effective --mfr is exactly `jlcpcb`. Observed 5 danger.
